title: Milgrom–Shannon's Monotonicity Theorem: the Full Characterization
abstract: Milgrom and Shannon (1994), Theorem 4, in both directions: for an arbitrary lattice X, partially ordered parameter space T, and real-valued objective, strong-set monotonicity of constrained maximizers over every pair of strongly ordered feasible subsets is equivalent to quasisupermodularity of every section and both weak and strict preference-preservation clauses of single crossing. The theorem imposes no finiteness, completeness, topology, continuity, compactness, nonemptiness, or optimizer existence assumptions. Supporting results and counterexamples distinguish crossing clauses and fixed-domain from varying-feasible-set monotonicity. Earlier Lean sufficiency results in Econlib and nonmathlib4 are explicitly cited.
authors: Ruy Jose Guerra Barretto de Queiroz
